# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 2480512915, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a hand-drawn map of a fictional land dotted with many little towns under a starry night sky, a spinning wheel of blank name cards in front, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
